instruction: Follow all the artists who have sung at least one song I have liked on Spotify.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) with no answer. The world state is abstracted into representative entities: liked-song-1/liked-song-2 (liked), other-song (not liked), artist-1 and artist-2 (sing liked songs, not yet followed -> must be followed), artist-3 (sings a liked song but already followed -> must not be re-followed; the evaluator requires no removed followings and added followings exactly equal to the missing liked-song artists), artist-4 (only sings a non-liked song -> must not be followed). Artists are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can enumerate every goal literal in its precondition (quantified goals are disallowed); they stand for runtime artist ids read from show_liked_songs/show_following_artists. spotify-follow-artist carries an extra non-API song parameter that justifies the follow via (liked ?s) and (sings ?ar ?s); it also requires (following-known) and (liked-songs-known) so the plan performs both lookups (paginate over all pages at runtime) before following, and (not (following ?ar)) prevents duplicate follows. Login requires both supervisor.show_profile (username = supervisor email) and supervisor.show_account_passwords, mirroring the reference solution. All non-final actions require (not (task-completed)); only supervisor-complete-task asserts it, so it is necessarily last.
